sources.title: Travelling to Niue
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government of Niue information page links this Tourism site. Its opened entry guidance links the Government's visitor application and Immigration Office. The detailed arrival-permit cohort omits New Zealand, but the same-page FAQ explicitly includes New Zealand among tourist visa-waiver countries.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visitors from visa-waiver countries (including New Zealand, Australia, Australia, the UK, and the US) do not need a visa

sources.title: Niue Laws Volume 2: Immigration Act 2011, consolidated as at 31 December 2019
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government's current legislation page links this official consolidation. Direct native PDF retrieval opened the Immigration Act at printed pages 243-254 after browser section retrieval timed out. Sections 3A-7 and 12-15 distinguish specified origin/residence exemptions, travel visas and stay permits; this is not a verified September 2026 nationality schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: To avoid doubt a visa does not entitle the holder to remain in Niue.

sources.title: Niue Legislation Supplement 2021-2024, Part 1
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government's current legislation index links this supplement and describes its cutoff as 31 December 2024. Direct native PDF retrieval opened its in-force tables: printed page 9 records later Immigration Act amendments and page 41 records the 2011 regulations. The table does not reproduce a New Zealand visitor exemption or prove subsequent completeness.

unresolved.reason: A single current ordinary-passport tourist route is not established. Tourism's FAQ explicitly includes New Zealand in its short tourist waiver, whereas its detailed arrival-permit list omits New Zealand and is followed by a general prior-visa instruction. Omission does not independently prove a prior-visa rule, and the FAQ does not prove that an arrival stay-permit is unnecessary. The official Act separates travel visas and stay permits and preserves specified Niue-origin/residence exemptions; the complete current implementing exemption rule was not retrieved. These findings do not establish that the snapshot arrival category is affirmatively false for every ordinary New Zealand visitor. No replacement category, multiple-status record or deadline extension is proposed.
